definitions.explanation: the process of transferring ownership of property or business from the government to the private sector

examples.japanese: ⟦{国有|こくゆう}→国有：28390_kokuyuu⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{私有化|しゆうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The privatization of state-owned enterprises is progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{私有化|しゆうか}をめぐって⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Debate continues over the privatization of land.

examples.japanese: ロシア⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1990⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{私有化|しゆうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われ→行う：01238_okonau⟧、⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: In Russia, large-scale privatization was carried out in the 1990s, and the economic structure changed dramatically.

notes:
The transfer of publicly owned assets or enterprises into private ownership. Composed of ⟦{私有|しゆう}→私有：19205_shiyuu⟧ (private ownership) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation suffix). Often discussed in the context of economic reform, particularly post-communist transitions and neoliberal policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国有|こくゆう}→国有：28390_kokuyuu⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{私有化|しゆうか} — privatization of state-owned enterprises
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{私有化|しゆうか} — privatization of land
- ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{私有化|しゆうか} — large-scale privatization
- {私有化|しゆうか}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ — privatization policy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{民営化|みんえいか}→民営化：17587_mineika⟧ — privatization (of operations/management; the more common term in Japanese domestic politics, e.g., postal privatization)
- ⟦{国有化|こくゆうか}→国有化：17588_kokuyuuka⟧ — nationalization (the opposite process)
- {公有化|こうゆうか} — transfer to public ownership

USAGE:
⟦{民営化|みんえいか}→民営化：17587_mineika⟧ and {私有化|しゆうか} both translate as "privatization" but differ in nuance. ⟦{民営化|みんえいか}→民営化：17587_mineika⟧ typically refers to transferring management or operations to private companies while the government may retain some ownership or oversight. {私有化|しゆうか} emphasizes full transfer of ownership to private hands.
